title: Aphorism § 219
text:
§ 219



 A comparison of these previous symptoms of the corporeal disease
          with the traces of them that still remain, though they have become less perceptible (but
          which even now sometimes become prominent, when a lucid interval and a transient
          alleviation of the psychical disease occurs), will serve to prove them to be still
          present, though obscured.
